input: 卡通橙色爆炸冲击，中等节奏，标准性能，不要长拖尾
root_cause: Negative constraint text was scanned as a positive timing clause; the character 长 in 不要长拖尾 overrode the intended medium timing.
fix: Parse timing only from text before negative markers such as 不要/避免/without/no.

observed: Only effect_family and one other feature were active; model predicted particle_v1 with probability 0.9993.
root_cause: A nested conditional-expression precedence bug encoded style, timing, performance and color as empty values.
fix: Use explicit per-field branches and a regression test requiring more than four active condition features.

observed: Validation contained no multi_particle rows and majority-class accuracy hid multi-profile failure.
fix: Stratify train/validation/test by target profile and use inverse-frequency class weights.

observed: Unity compile pass and all PNG files valid, but both captures were all background pixels and finalized as near_blank.
root_cause: Generated Graphs directly bound audited source materials; that skipped the runtime-verified clone-template plus deterministic texture route.
fix: Prefer Mat_fozu_03 with prior runtime-visible evidence, clone it in the compiler, and bind generated spark/soft_disc Texture2D profiles.

input: 写实青色刀光，快速爆发，标准性能，不要长拖尾
observed: effect_family=explosion for all eight slash candidates
root_cause: The generic motion word 爆发 was included in explosion family terms and matched before the explicit 刀光 family noun.
fix: Keep 爆发/冲击 as motion terms; restrict explosion family matching to 爆炸/explosion and add a slash regression test.
